source: GitHub Actions actual Gmsh C3D10 STEP CalculiX and BEAN SpongeTD runs
exercise: Axial tension/compression, Y-directed cantilever bending, round-shaft pure torsion

earlier_run.defect: Reference beam bends around Z from transverse Y force; initial code incorrectly used I_y instead of I_z for nonsquare section

root_cause: A physically incorrect reference can make a learned correction seem beneficial. Fix coordinate conventions/section properties before treating a surrogate residual as material physics.
recovered_lesson: For this supported simple linear elastic geometry, use the known analytical reference; the tested bounded Q correction brought no accuracy gain on unseen geometry.
scope_limitation: Neither run measures fracture, buckling, nonlinear plasticity, weld/bolt load transfer, fatigue or real building-code compliance.
durable_source: This snapshot is permanent GitHub-tracked summary. Full solver traces and local SQLite Q journal are in temporary 90-day Actions artifacts; regenerate from tracked source.
future_work: Transfer to structural assembly connectors, unsupported geometries, contact stress and material failure using separate independently verified native/experimental reference sets.
